purpose: Dated public capability and pricing priors for a held-out post-KnowledgeAgent DebugAgent selector experiment.
interpretation: Vendor positioning and documented API features are prior information, not KubeLLM Ground Truth evidence. Empirical KubeLLM outcomes remain unknown until paired runs complete.

router.role: Fixed selector model for both Decisions and Responses conditions; the selected model is the DebugAgent candidate.

runtime_compatibility.result: A small Decisions API typed-choice probe and a Responses structured-output choice probe both returned valid registered candidates; neither used a KubeLLM benchmark case.

candidates.vendor_position: Lower-cost, faster tier in the documented model ladder.
capability_claims: Luna is positioned for fast, cost-efficient inference.
The model card documents function calling and structured outputs.
